entries.description: List of user or group capability mappings. Each entry specifies a selector (user, group, or @all) and a space-separated list of Linux capabilities (e.g., CAP_NET_BIND_SERVICE, CAP_CHOWN).

capabilities.description: List of Linux capability names (e.g., CAP_NET_RAW, CAP_SYS_TIME, CAP_SETUID). Case-insensitive; hyphens and underscores interchangeable.
